verdict.rationale: Appwrite's own docs say developers can "use one of our many SDKs" alongside REST and GraphQL. The CLI's generate command produces a type-safe SDK tailored to the project's schema, and the official specs repo ships SDK code examples for all supported versions. Agent skills and the docs also target SDK-accurate code, which suits an AI-native workflow. Missing for 10: an explicit list of supported SDK languages and versions in the evidence, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: You can use one of our many SDKs or integrate directly through the REST API or GraphQL API.
The generate command creates a type-safe SDK tailored to your project.
This repository contains the official Appwrite API specifications and SDK code examples for all supported versions
Skills are open-source Markdown files that give AI agents deep knowledge of Appwrite SDKs and services.
Teach agents your backend so they make SDK-accurate calls.
